root_cause.text: After commit aab5c6f20023 removed the device release callback, the error handling paths in gpiochip_add_data_with_key() no longer drop the device reference count after device_initialize(), causing resource leaks.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Since commit aab5c6f20023 ('gpio: set device type for GPIO chips'), `gdev->dev.release` is unset. As a result, the reference count to `gdev->dev` isn't dropped on the error handling paths." The patch diff shows the old code conditionally called gpio_device_put() only when `gdev->dev.release` was set, while the new code unconditionally uses gpio_device_put() after device_initialize() to properly cleanup.
